rows.grounds: indeclinable indicating equivalence with the previously stated procedure
locative expressing the initial stage of the ritual action
optative prescribing the ritual act of drawing
direct object denoting the ritual diagram to be drawn
fused token: devatāyāḥ (of-deity) + ca (and) + vigraham (form); coordinated object of drawing

items.question: What initial drawing is required when a pre-existing ritual diagram is unavailable?
premises: A pre-existing ritual diagram may be absent.
An initial ritual act can supply the required support.
The prescribed drawing includes both the diagram and the deity's form.
items.inference: Therefore one should first draw the ritual diagram together with the deity's form.
items.plain_english: Likewise, at the outset one should draw the yantra and the form of the deity.
